name: Bloodmoon
author: Nola Drift
description: Bloodmoon by Nola Drift (SammiBabe666) is a gothic organ. Every note is a pipe with its 2nd, 3rd and 4th harmonics, and a bell strikes on top of it. The bell's two partials sit a little off the organ, close to a minor third, so it never quite agrees with the pipes. A slow vibrato fades in after the attack, with a faint wobble under it, so held notes drift like old pipes.
credits: Nola Drift's Project Bloodmoon, published by SammiBabe666, brought into kennel by Hundekraft
